question: Which Indian president used the pocket veto for the Indian Post Office (Amendment) Bill, 1986?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Giani Zail Singh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Giani Zail Singh, the President of India from 1982 till 1987, exercised a pocket veto to prevent the Indian Post Office (Amendment) Bill from becoming law**.
 
• A pocket veto **allows a president to exercise veto power over a bill by taking no action.**
 
• **Article 111** of the I
